scanner.label: Retail scanner prices
scanner.method: Average prices from transactions at participating grocery retailers. Product mixes can change. Additional retailers entered the sample in January 2024. Whitehorse and Yellowknife first appear in September 2025.

survey.label: Retail price survey
survey.method: National averages from the CPI price collection, weighted by area population. Brands and outlets varied. The sample changed in May 2018. Statistics Canada discontinued this table after February 2022.

print.label: Printed urban food tables
print.method: Published annual retail price averages for urban Canada. Butter is first-grade creamery; bread is white, wrapped and sliced; flour is white all-purpose; eggs are fresh Grade A large. Sugar is granulated. Prices are cents per pound or dozen.

yearbook.label: Canada Year Book benchmarks
yearbook.method: Statistics Canada aligned ten package sizes for 1935 and 2008 in Table 25.b. The default basket is one of each. The article also gives individual egg and milk observations for 1960 and 1985. Other items in those years have no reported price. Quart milk and partly skimmed milk are separate specifications.
